page.overview:
What is Hoenn Battle Frontier?

The Battle Frontier is an area introduced in Generation III, and it appears only in .

The Battle Frontier features seven different facilities where the player can take part in Pokémon battles against Pokémon Trainers and Frontier Brains. The Battle Frontier was founded by Scott in order to accomplish his dream of making the toughest challenges for Trainers as well as finding Trainers that can beat them. In Pokémon Emerald, the Battle Frontier is only accessed if the player has defeated the regional Elite Four. After beating the Elite Four, the player can get to the Battle Frontier via the S.S Tidal.

There is also a Sudowoodo next to the Battle Palace. If the player asks an old lady standing in between the trees, she will probably say something about a weird tree. It is located near the waterfall. Approach the tree and attempt to water it with the Wailmer Pail. The tree springs to life, revealing that it's no ordinary tree. Battle Sudowoodo to capture it. It is at Level 40.

In , the player is asked to enter one of two categories: Level 50 or 'Open Level'. In Level 50, the player can enroll Pokémon between level 5 and 50. All of the opponents' Pokémon are exactly level 50. In Open Level, the player can enter level 50–100, but it is advisable to enroll Pokémon leveled 60–100 because none of the opponents have Pokémon anywhere above level 60.
